before: Text of a shape in a canvas or a group lays out in the whole member box, a turned inline shape takes its unturned room, and a run border takes no room on the line.
after: Member text lays out in the text rectangle of the shape less half of the outline, a turned inline shape takes its turned room, and a run border, an effect extent, and the outline of an inline VML text box take their room on each line.
reason: Only drawing projection, layout, and paint change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged, and each participant derives the same geometry from the same source XML.
